description: Load a serialized report and recursively summarize nested records.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary serialized report summarization software, not an evolutionary algorithm. Pickle input can contain cyclic containers, and summarize recursively traverses them without cycle detection. Recursive traversal has no cycle/depth guard. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
